audience: engineering and on-call teams that triage app errors in Bugsnag

useCases.title: Find the errors that hit the most users
useCases.text: List the projects of an organization. Then list the errors of one project with their event and user counts.

useCases.title: Read the newest stack trace
useCases.text: List the events of one error, newest first. Open an event to read its exception, stack trace and breadcrumbs.

useCases.title: Check how stable each release was
useCases.text: List the releases of a project and read its stability trend. Open one release to see its errors and session counts.

useCases.title: Mark an error as fixed and comment
useCases.text: Set an error to fixed, ignored or snoozed, or link it to an issue. Then add a comment that the team can read.
